name: Turkey and Bacon Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Remove excess grease by pressing cooked bacon on disposable paper towel.
Chop bacon strips into small pieces.
Shred lettuce either by hand or with a knife.
Lay desired amount of lettuce in clean bowl, a minimum of 2 cups recommended.
Roll deli turkey to form a slender shape.
Slowly slice turkey into circular shapes.
Pile carrots, olive, bacon, and turkey on lettuce.
Top off with your favorite dressing.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
